stories.headline: Opposition parties block Taiwan's defense budget as US senators criticize delay

stories.headline: Hong Kong media tycoon Jimmy Lai sentenced to 20 years in prison

stories.summary: Defense Minister Wellington Koo announced Taiwan will conduct its Han Kuang 42 military exercises for 10 days in August, focusing on decentralized command capabilities, urban resilience, and live-fire operations. The drills will integrate with local government air raid exercises.
